events.title: U.S. GDP Surges Much More Than Previously Estimated In Q3
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday showed the U.S. economy grew by much more than previously estimated in the third quarter of 2026.

events.title: U.S. Durable Goods Orders Rise Less Than Expected In October
events.description: New orders for U.S. manufactured durable goods increased by less than expected in the month of October, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Fall Much More Than Expected
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Wednesday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits fell by much more than expected in the week ended November 21st.

events.title: U.S. PCE Price Index Rises 0.3% In October, In Line With Estimates
events.description: Consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of October, according to a closely watched report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Pares Early Gains
events.description: The UK market's benchmark index FTSE 100 pared early gains and was down slightly a little past noon on Wednesday, weighed down by losses in mining and bank stocks. FMCG stocks found good support.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rallies Amid U.S. Tariff Threats, AI Bubble Fears
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as news that the U.S. administration is thinking of imposing further tariffs on allies and new concerns about the sustainability of the AI boom, reduced risk appetite.

events.title: CAC 40 Advances As Luxury Stocks Move Up
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 climbed higher on Wednesday, led by strong gains in luxury stock. Data showing an improvement in French consumer confidence in November, and the French National Assembly's nod to the year-end budget bill helped underpin sentiment.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.

events.title: Indian Shares Stage Strong Recovery
events.description: Indian shares ended Wednesday's session on a buoyant note, bringing benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty closer to their record highs as softer crude oil prices, unwinding of the AI trade across the globe and renewed foreign fund inflows outweighed fresh U.S. tariff worries.

events.title: DAX Roughly Flat As Investors Await U.S. PCE Data
events.description: German stocks moved in a tight range Wednesday morning as concerns about interest rates and possibile hike in tariffs, and uncertainty about returns on AI infrastructure spending rendered the mood cautious.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower Ahead Of US PCE Inflation Data
events.description: Gold prices drifted lower on Wednesday as investors braced for today's U.S. inflation reading and a possible tariff announcement from the Trump administration to replace levies struck down by the Supreme Court earlier this year.

events.title: Oil Prices Recoup Early Losses With Supply Risks In Focus
events.description: Oil prices were little changed on Wednesday, recovering early losses after Yemen's Houth group claimed that it had carried out two military operations targeting the Ras Tanura oil refinery in Saudi Arabia's Eastern province and the financial center in King Abdullah Economic City in Riyadh.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher Ahead Of US PCE Inflation Data
events.description: European stocks were moving higher on Wednesday as crude oil prices fell around 1 percent despite further attacks around the Strait of Hormuz.
